findings.reason: A concrete picture materially clarifies the nonstandard keyhole interior: it includes the disk and the left wedge, so the larger-angle/smaller-radius contour is inside the other contour, while the reverse pole lies outside. Separating finite closure from infinite nesting exposes exactly the geometry used in steps 1.2 and 2.1. This is warranted explanatory content even though the existing rigorous proof is complete.

diagram_math_checks.objects: Left: Gamma_R(r,theta), C_R and D_R in the complex plane.
diagram_math_checks.check: Used r=0.9, R=2.6, theta=120 degrees. The lower segment runs inward from radius R to r at -theta, the inner arc increases from -theta to theta through the right half-plane, and the upper segment runs outward. The dashed outer arc increases from theta to 360-theta through the left half-plane. Its endpoints coincide with the two ray tips, giving the explicit closed four-piece contour of step 1.2. This has positive winding about 0, with inner/outer angular increments 240 and 120 degrees, totaling 360 degrees.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Local step 1.2 defines the appended outer arc and D_R; the contour supplier Statement defines the lower ray, inner arc and upper ray. The orientation agrees with the supplier proof step 3.1 initial and terminal points.

diagram_math_checks.objects: Right: Gamma_1 with r_1=1.25, theta_1=115 degrees; Gamma_2 with r_2=0.65, theta_2=140 degrees.
diagram_math_checks.check: The Gamma_2 arc has modulus r_2<r_1, so it is inside the disk part of D_infinity,1. Every Gamma_2 ray has |arg|=theta_2>theta_1, so lies in its wedge part. Conversely Gamma_1 arc and rays all have modulus at least r_1>r_2 and |arg|<=theta_1<theta_2, hence avoid the closure of D_infinity,2. The displayed angular choices are schematic admissible examples for a sufficiently large delta, not claims of uniform numerical parameters for all delta.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Exact D_R formula in step 1.2, union defining D_infinity, and nesting inequalities of step 1.1.

diagram_math_checks.objects: Marked pole lambda_1 at 2.2 exp(i theta_1), lambda_2 at 2.05 exp(i theta_2).
diagram_math_checks.check: Each filled point lies on its corresponding upper ray. lambda_1 is outside closure D_infinity,2, giving zero for the inner Gamma_2 integral in A_1. lambda_2 is inside D_infinity,1, giving 2 pi i exp(lambda_2 z_1) for the inner Gamma_1 integral in A_2. No boundary-pole case is illustrated or asserted.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Step 2.1 fixes precisely these two pole locations; step 1.2 gives their winding cases. The figure adds no analytical assumption and the original six-step proof is untouched.
